gaps.notes: 0% of scored test answers matched how your site describes itself and included at least one link to it.
gaps.remediation: You cannot edit ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity directly, so there is no setting that makes them link to your site. What can help is having pages worth citing: one clear page for each thing you offer, each at a single stable address with a canonical URL, that answers the question in plain text near the top. Links to those pages from independent sources, such as directories, press coverage and industry lists, can also help, because these models draw on what other sites say. Estimated effort: 2 to 4 hours.
